primitives.name: Tissue-Specific Injury Decay Kernel
primitives.verbatim_quote: GSI's tissue-specific decay curves (syndesmotic ankle cutting loss, biceps femoris high-speed running deficit, spat/brace impulse penalty) convert raw injury tags into position-specific EPA and target/carry share adjustments.
primitives.symbol_and_unit_ledger: {'t_{decay}': 'time in days', 'EPA_{pos}': 'expected points added per play, dimensionless', 'T_{tissue}': 'tissue type identifier, categorical'}
primitives.assumptions: Injury severity decays exponentially with time; position-specific impacts are modeled via empirical regression coefficients.
primitives.breakdown_regime: t_{decay} → ∞ implies full recovery; T_{tissue} ∈ {ankle, hamstring, etc.}

primitives.name: NFL Matchup Health Biomarker Engine
primitives.verbatim_quote: ## Consequences ### Positive - Every NFL matchup evaluation automatically executes GSI `Step 2 (2_health)` biomarker, strain, and return-to-play survival calculations.
primitives.assumptions: Biomarkers are independent and jointly distributed; strain is additive across tissues.
primitives.breakdown_regime: P_{rtm} < 0.5 ⇒ player not cleared for play

layer2.mapping: Transforms raw physiological data into actionable risk metrics via ensemble prediction models.
layer2.telemetry: Player clearance decisions based on integrated biomarker thresholds.

primitives.assumptions: Clinical stages must be completed before biomarker-driven clearance.

layer2.mapping: Enforces a causal chain between clinical validation and automated clearance decisions.
layer2.telemetry: Compliance score tracking via protocol stage completion.
